notes:
CRM: Keyboard only: New Rule reachable and opens with Enter; Tab moves through name, description, Layout, Field to check, Active, rule type, behaviour, Field verification, error position, Cancel, Save and wraps inside the dialog (focus kept in the dialog); every stop has a visible focus ring; Layout picker opens with Enter, Arrow + Enter picks a layout; Escape closes the dialog (crm-M3-keyboard.png). Fixing a refused field by keyboard: focus is moved to the bad field on a refused save (see M4)
DESK: Desk uses the same rule editor; keyboard pass checked on CRM (M3). Not repeated on Desk
